description.value: The Polson Park Motel is a mid-sized motel sitting directly opposite Polson Park in central Vernon, BC, on Highway 97. Rooms range from standard queen configurations to kitchenette units, and the property features a courtyard with barbecue and an outdoor pool. Its central location puts cyclists within easy reach of downtown Vernon, restaurants, and the Vernon Jubilee Hospital.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the motel is a real, operating property in Vernon BC across from Polson Park. The amenities list on the website is detailed and confirms free wireless internet; no mention is made of bike storage, staff bike procedures, laundry, or most other cycling-specific amenities, so those are null. A spam/SEO string ('Online Casinos Review | Top Online Casino') appears in the footer of multiple pages, suggesting possible website compromise, which is flagged in concerns.
concerns: Website footer contains the string 'Online Casinos Review | Top Online Casino' on at least two pages, suggesting the site may have been compromised by SEO spam injection. Website content otherwise appears legitimate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel with an active website and confirmed contact details in central Vernon; suitable for touring cyclists seeking accommodation.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states 'Close to restaurants, golf courses and downtown.'
